FULFILLING THE JOURNEY
      ANNUAL REPORT 年報 2023
We are extremely pleased with Samsonite’s performance in 2023. With the ongoing growth
in travel and tourism around the world, we achieved strong net sales increases across all our
regions and core brands. We also achieved a record high gross profit margin, and we remained
disciplined with our expense management, which helped to significantly enhance our profitability.

我們對新秀麗於2023年的表現甚感欣慰。隨着全球旅遊業及觀光業的持續增長，我們所有地區及核
心品牌的銷售淨額均實現強勁增長。我們的毛利率亦創歷史新高，同時我們繼續嚴格管理開支，這
有助大幅提升我們的盈利能力。


Timothy Charles Parker
Chairman 主席

Corporate Profile                                                           公司簡介

“Company”), together with its consolidated subsidiaries (the “Group”),      附屬公司統稱為「本集團」）的悠久歷史可追溯
is a leader in the global lifestyle bag industry and is the world’s best-   至 1910 年，是全球時尚箱包行業的翹楚，並
known and largest travel luggage company. The Group is principally          且是全球最著名、規模最大的行李箱公司。本
engaged in the design, manufacture, sourcing and distribution of            集團主要在全球從事設計、製造、採購及分銷
luggage, business and computer bags, outdoor and casual bags                行李箱、商務包及電腦包、戶外包及休閒包
and travel accessories throughout the world, primarily under the            以及旅遊配件，旗下品牌主要包括新秀麗 ® 、
Samsonite , Tumi , American Tourister , Gregory , High Sierra ,

  enhancements to our global retail store network. We are confident that the Group will continue to deliver
  robust net sales growth and be vigilant in limiting promotional discounts to sustain our improved gross
  profit margin. At the same time, we will continue to focus on cash management, deleveraging our
  balance sheet, investing in organic growth, and returning cash to our shareholders.
  展望2024年，預計全球旅遊業及觀光業維持穩健增長。於2024年，我們將繼續投資於我們的核心品
  牌，專注於產品創新、可持續發展方案及進一步加強我們的全球零售店網絡。我們相信，本集團將繼
  續實現強勁的銷售淨額增長並嚴格限制促銷折扣，以維持我們經提高的毛利率。與此同時，我們將繼
  續專注於現金管理、資產負債表去槓桿化、投資於自然增長以及向股東作出現金回報。

Notes 註釋
(1) The geographic location of the Group’s net sales generally reflects the country/territory from which its products were sold and does not
    necessarily indicate the country/territory in which its end customers were actually located.
    本集團銷售淨額的地域位置分佈一般反映出售產品的國家 ╱ 地區，並不一定為終端客戶實際所在的國家 ╱ 地區。
(2) Includes net sales made domestically as well as net sales to distributors in certain other Asian markets.
    包括於本地錄得的銷售淨額以及向若干其他亞洲市場的分銷商所錄得的銷售淨額。
(3) Net sales reported for Hong Kong include net sales made in Macau.
    香港呈報的銷售淨額包括於澳門錄得的銷售淨額。
(4) Results stated on a constant currency basis, a non-IFRS measure, are calculated by applying the average exchange rate of the year under
    comparison to current year local currency results.
    按不變匯率基準計算呈列的業績為非IFRS計量工具，是以當地貨幣呈列的本年度業績採用與其相比較年度的平均匯率計算所得。

      business and computer bags, outdoor and casual bags and travel                 李箱、商務包及電腦包、戶外包及休閒

      comply after the reporting date (future covenants) do not affect a                契約）不會影響負債於該日期的分類。然
      liability’s classification at that date. However, when non-current                而，當非流動負債受未來契約約束時，

21. Financial Risk Management and Financial                                     21. 財務風險管理及金融工具
    Instruments
      The Group has exposure to the following risks from its use of                   本集團因使用金融工具而面對下列風
      financial instruments:                                                          險：


      •        credit risk;                                                           •      信貸風險；

      •        market risk.                                                           •      市場風險。


(a)   Risk Management                                                           (a)   風險管理
      The Company’s Board of Directors is responsible for ensuring that               本公司董事會負責確保本公司制訂及維
      the Company establishes and maintains appropriate and effective                 持適當及有效的風險管理及內部控制系
      risk management and internal control systems. The Board of                      統。董事會已授權審核委員會負責檢討
      Directors has delegated to the Audit Committee the responsibility               本集團的風險管理及內部控制系統。在
      for reviewing the Group’s risk management and internal control                  董事會的監察下，本公司的管理層負責
      systems. The Company’s management, under the oversight of the                   設計、實施及監察本公司的風險管理及
      Board of Directors, is responsible for the design, implementation               內部控制系統。
      and monitoring of the Company’s risk management and internal
      control systems.


(b)   Exposure to Credit Risk                                                   (b)   所承擔的信貸風險
      Credit risk is the risk of financial loss to the Group if a customer or         信貸風險為倘金融工具的客戶或交易對
      counterparty to a financial instrument fails to meet its contractual            手未能履行其合約責任而令本集團承受

      Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or                公允價值是於計量日市場參與者於有秩
      paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market             序交易中出售資產可收取或轉讓負債須

      establish a fair value hierarchy that prioritizes the inputs to valuation         允價值等級架構，該架構排列用以計量
      techniques used to measure fair value. The hierarchy gives the                    公允價值的估值方法輸入數據的優先等
      highest priority to unadjusted quoted prices in active markets for                級。該等級架構給予於活躍市場中相同

      (Level 3 measurements). The three levels of the fair value hierarchy              輸入數據的計量最低等級（第三級別計
      are as follows:                                                                   量）。公允價值等級架構的三個級別如

              markets for identical assets or liabilities that the Group has                   力於計量日取得的相同資產或
